fuel_consumption.source_quote: A hypothetical 10% increase in the December 31, 2006 cost per gallon of fuel, assuming projected 2007 mainline and regional aircraft fuel usage, would result in an increase to aircraft fuel expense of approximately $357 million in 2007.

instrument_type_details.notes: Collar options (crude oil put options with calls) ~30% of 2007 fuel; fixed price crude oil swap agreements ~10% of 2007 fuel. No fuel derivative contracts designated for hedge accounting treatment as of December 31, 2006; unrealized losses/gains recognized through statement of operations. Company still in Chapter 11 bankruptcy (filed Sep 14, 2005; emerged May 31, 2007).

warnings: Company in Chapter 11 bankruptcy during entire FY2006 (filed Sep 14, 2005; emerged May 31, 2007).
Fuel derivatives not designated for hedge accounting; fair value changes recognized through P&L rather than OCI. Net fair value reported as 0 (no OCI balance).
